name: tagr
description: Tagr is a self-hosted music metadata editor with a modern web UI. Browse, edit, and manage audio file tags from any browser — desktop or mobile. Just point it at your music folders and get a clean three-panel interface for organizing your library. Edit 40+ metadata fields, manage album art, fetch metadata from MusicBrainz, and more.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Path to store the SQLite database and app data.

paths.name: Music Folder 1
paths.description: Path to a music folder on the host. Add more paths as needed.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: SQLite database path inside the container.

variables.name: AUTH_SECRET
variables.description: Secret key for session encryption. Change this to a random string.

variables.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Login password as a bcrypt hash. Generate with: docker exec tagr node -e "require('bcrypt').hash('yourpassword',12).then(console.log)"

variables.name: AUTH_URL
variables.description: Public URL of the app (used by NextAuth).
